# Earth geographic backdrop

Source: Natural Earth, 1:110m land geometry.
URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson
Downloaded: 2026-09-18
Vendored SHA256: `9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9`

Natural Earth data is public domain:
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

`tools/build_v3_earth.py` creates the static orthographic land-dot backdrop.
The globe is geographic context only. Synthetic A–H states are not assigned to
real countries; no transport/network routes or measured quantities are drawn
inside this asset. Brightness is illustrative lighting, not an observation.
